name: MAP 00 – AI Business: 12 agents connected (Kaamchor AI)

parameters.content:
# ▶ START HERE
**12 AI agents, 1 business, 1 Google Sheet.**

**Hinglish:**
1. Ek Google Sheet banao, tabs: `Leads`, `Bookings`, `Content`, `Reviews`, `Bills`, `Candidates`, `Invoices`, `Daily Log` (pehli row = headers).
2. `Ctrl+F` se `YOUR_` dhoondo, apni Sheet ID / WhatsApp number ID / number daalo.
3. Credentials add karo: **Anthropic (Claude)** + **Google** (Sheets, Gmail, Calendar).
4. Sab triggers OFF (disabled) hain. Ek department ka trigger ON karo (right-click → Activate), test karo, phir agla.
5. Shuru karo **Ops** ya **10 Bill Reader** se: sirf Gmail + Sheets + Claude chahiye.

**English:** make the sheet with those tabs, replace every `YOUR_...`, add Claude + Google credentials, then enable ONE department's trigger at a time and test it before the next. WhatsApp agents also need a WhatsApp Business Cloud number.

**Setup mein help chahiye? Free call book karo:** https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/schedules/AcZssZ2ZI6Dqh2h1_ZDYvYyeQvzmzxSRp9yCcr0mHPj0WDpbplw-pbnv-e_5B6NI8tjpjhDK8GYfs2ol

Part of **MAP – 12 AI agents** (Kaamchor AI).

# 👑 OWNER / MANAGER
Every night 9 PM: reads every tab of your sheet → Claude writes your report → WhatsApp to you + Daily Log tab.

# ⚙️ OPS
**10 Bill Reader** → Bills tab (Manager totals them)
**11 Resume Screener** → Candidates tab
**12 Invoice Chaser** reads Invoices tab, 8 PM

# 📣 MARKETING
**07 SEO Team** → WordPress draft + Content tab
**08 Video→Posts** → Content tab
**09 Reviews** → Reviews tab, angry ones → you

# 🎧 SUPPORT
**04 Receptionist** ← gets booking chats from the shared WhatsApp router · logs Bookings
**05 Missed Call** → hands the caller to 03 Qualifier
**06 Inbox Sorter** drafts replies, nothing auto-sent

# 💼 SALES
**01 Lead Finder** → Leads tab
**02 WA Replier** → hands every new chat to 03 Qualifier
**03 Qualifier** 🔥 hot → WhatsApp alert to you + booking offer → 04 Receptionist

### 01 Lead Finder
→ Leads tab  ·  needs: Places API key · Claude · Sheets

### 02 WA Replier
→ hands every new chat to 03 Qualifier  ·  needs: WhatsApp Cloud · Claude

### 03 Qualifier
🔥 hot → WhatsApp alert to you + booking offer → 04 Receptionist  ·  needs: Claude · Sheets · WhatsApp

### 04 Receptionist
← gets booking chats from the shared WhatsApp router · logs Bookings  ·  needs: WhatsApp Cloud · Claude · Google Calendar · Sheets

### 05 Missed Call
→ hands the caller to 03 Qualifier  ·  needs: call webhook · Claude · WhatsApp

### 06 Inbox Sorter
drafts replies, nothing auto-sent  ·  needs: Gmail · Claude

### 07 SEO Team
→ WordPress draft + Content tab  ·  needs: Places + WordPress · Claude

### 08 Video→Posts
→ Content tab  ·  needs: transcript API key · Claude · Sheets

### 09 Reviews
→ Reviews tab, angry ones → you  ·  needs: Google Business Profile · Gmail · Claude · Sheets

### 10 Bill Reader
→ Bills tab (Manager totals them)  ·  needs: Gmail · Claude · Sheets

### 11 Resume Screener
→ Candidates tab  ·  needs: Gmail · Claude · Sheets

### 12 Invoice Chaser
reads Invoices tab, 8 PM  ·  needs: Sheets · Gmail · Claude

parameters.text:
=You are the manager of a small business run by 12 AI agents. Write tonight's WhatsApp report for the owner.
Language: simple Hinglish. Max 12 short lines. One line per department with an emoji (💼 Sales, 🎧 Support, 📣 Marketing, ⚙️ Ops), then '👉 Kal ke 3 kaam:' with the 3 most important actions (hot leads to call first, angry reviews, overdue money). Use only the numbers below; if something is 0 say so in a few words. No greeting paragraph.

Today's numbers:
{{ JSON.stringify($json, null, 2) }}

assignments.name: my_offer
assignments.value: We build AI receptionists that answer every call and WhatsApp and book appointments 24/7.

nodes.name: Lead Finder · One row per business
Lead Finder · Claude writes first line
Lead Finder · Save to Google Sheet

options.systemMessage: You are the WhatsApp assistant of YOUR BUSINESS NAME. Reply in the customer's language (Hinglish is fine), max 3 short lines, warm and helpful. Answer the question if you can, then ask ONE qualifying question (what they need / budget / area). Never invent prices you were not given. Return ONLY JSON: {"reply": "...", "name": "...", "phone": "...", "need": "...", "budget": "..."}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ body: { name: $('WA Replier · Parse JSON').item.json.name || $('Customer WhatsApp (in)').item.json.contacts?.[0]?.profile?.name || '', phone: $('Customer WhatsApp (in)').item.json.messages[0].from, email: '', source: 'WhatsApp', message: ($('Customer WhatsApp (in)').item.json.messages[0].text?.body || '') + ' | need: ' + ($('WA Replier · Parse JSON').item.json.need || '') + ' | budget: ' + ($('WA Replier · Parse JSON').item.json.budget || '') } }) }}

parameters.textBody: =Hi {{ $json.Name || '' }} 🙌 Aapki enquiry mil gayi. Ek quick call ya visit book kar dein? Bas apna convenient din aur time reply kijiye, slot main confirm kar dunga.

options.systemMessage: You are the WhatsApp receptionist of YOUR BUSINESS (hours 10:00-19:00, 30-min slots, closed Sunday). Reply in the customer's language (Hinglish is fine). Use the calendar tool to check which slots are busy before proposing one. Only book when the customer has agreed to a specific time. Return ONLY JSON: {"book": true|false, "name": "...", "reason": "...", "start": "ISO datetime or null", "end": "ISO datetime or null", "reply": "message to send"}

parameters.textBody: =Reminder: your appointment is tomorrow, {{ DateTime.fromISO($('Receptionist · Parse JSON').item.json.start).toFormat('dd LLL, h:mm a') }} . Reply here if you need to reschedule.

parameters.text: =Missed call from {{ $json.body.from }} at {{ $json.body.time }}. Known customer name: {{ $json.body.name || 'unknown' }}.

options.systemMessage: You are the assistant of YOUR BUSINESS NAME. The owner missed a call because he is on a job. Write a short, warm WhatsApp message in the customer's language (English or Hinglish). Start with "Hello ji", never "Namaste": say sorry for missing the call, ask what they need and their area, promise a callback. Return JSON: reply, lead_name, phone.

parameters.textBody: ={{ (() => { const r = $json.output || ''; const m = r.match(/\{[\s\S]*\}/); try { return m ? JSON.parse(m[0]).reply : r; } catch (e) { return r; } })() }}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ body: { name: $('Missed Call · Missed call').item.json.body.name || '', phone: $('Missed Call · Missed call').item.json.body.from, email: '', source: 'Missed call', message: 'Missed call (auto text-back sent on WhatsApp)' } }) }}

options.systemMessage: You sort the inbox of YOUR NAME (YOUR ROLE). Classify the email and decide if a human reply is needed. Categories: lead, client, invoice, newsletter, other. If a reply is needed, write a short draft in the sender's language and in a friendly, direct tone; never promise dates, prices or meetings you were not told about. Return ONLY JSON: {"category": "...", "needs_reply": true|false, "draft": "..."}

assignments.name: facts
assignments.value: Phone: (000) 000-0000. Open Mon–Sat 7am–7pm. Same-day visits when booked before noon. Licensed and insured. EDIT THESE TO YOUR REAL FACTS.

parameters.text:
=You manage Google reviews for a local business.
Business: Bright Smile Dental. Tone: warm, short, human, thank them by first name, never argue, never mention prices or medical details, sign off as 'The Bright Smile team'.

REVIEW ({{ $json.stars }} stars) from {{ $json.name }}:
{{ $json.comment }}

Classify the sentiment (happy / neutral / angry). angry = 1-2 stars OR a complaint, threat, refund demand or anything legal. Write a reply of max 60 words in the brand voice. For angry reviews also write a one-line summary for the owner.

parameters.subject: =Angry {{ $('Reviews · Only unanswered').item.json.stars }}-star review from {{ $('Reviews · Only unanswered').item.json.name }}

options.systemMessage: Extract data from this bill/invoice. Use null for anything not present; never guess. Date as YYYY-MM-DD, amount and gst as plain numbers. Return ONLY JSON: {"vendor": "...", "invoice_no": "...", "date": "...", "amount": 0, "gst": 0, "currency": "INR"}

parameters.jsonOutput: ={{ JSON.stringify({ Date: $now.toISODate(), ...$json, file: $('Bill Reader · Gmail Trigger').item.binary?.attachment_0?.fileName, received: $('Bill Reader · Gmail Trigger').item.json.date }) }}

filters.q: has:attachment filename:pdf (resume OR CV OR application OR job)

parameters.text:
=You are an expert HR recruiter. Score this candidate's resume against the job description.

=== EDIT THIS: JOB DESCRIPTION ===
Role: Sales Executive
Must have: 1+ years B2B / field sales, Excel, CRM (any), good communication (Hindi + English)
Nice to have: lead generation, cold calling, local market knowledge
Location: Pune (on-site)
=== END ===

RESUME TEXT:
{{ $json.text }}

Return: candidate name, email, phone, total years of experience (number), top 5 relevant skills, a score from 0 to 10 for fit with the job, a one-line reason, and status = "Shortlist" if score >= 7 else "Reject". Be strict and fair; judge only on skills and experience.

parameters.jsonSchemaExample:
{
  "name": "Rohan Verma",
  "email": "candidate@example.com",
  "phone": "+1 555 0100",
  "experience_years": 3,
  "skills": [
    "B2B Sales",
    "Excel",
    "CRM",
    "Cold calling",
    "Lead generation"
  ],
  "score": 8.5,
  "reason": "3 yrs field B2B sales, CRM + Excel",
  "status": "Shortlist"
}

parameters.text:
=You write payment reminder emails for Northwind Studio (a small agency).

Invoice {{ $json['Invoice No'] }} for {{ $json['Amount'] }} to {{ $json['Client'] }} (contact: {{ $json['Contact name'] }}) was due on {{ $json['Due date'] }}. It is {{ $json.days_overdue }} days overdue. Reminders already sent: {{ $json.reminders }}.

Tone: {{ $json.tone }}.
- friendly: assume they forgot, short and warm.
- firm: clear, mention the due date and ask for a payment date.
- final: polite but serious, say work may pause and late fees may apply per our terms.

Max 120 words. No guilt-tripping. Return a subject and a plain-text body signed 'Accounts, Northwind Studio'.
